title: The edge of the fog
prompt: The edge of town where a dirt path leaves the last fence and runs into thick pale fog. Beside the path, a single dead flower on a bent stem, its head closed and grey. The far end of the path vanishes in white. A little low light that is not quite where the sun should be.
story: The ending: at the edge of the ordinary world a dead flower opens (variant 'open', in a third colour, gold) and someone calls 'Come on'.

variants.open: the dead flower has opened: a single bloom with petals of warm gold light, the fog around it slightly parted, the light bending the wrong way; nothing else changed
